comments.body:
Quest name: Site of Battle of Salamis
Quest location: Stockholm/St Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Geography, Greek
Reward: 354k ducats, 85 cultural contribution

As with other r17 quests, it requires the appropriate Boston Academy skill for it to appear. In this case, Cartographer's Growth I
